name: Spring Health
short_description: Spring Health is a B2B enterprise mental health benefits platform with precision matching, data-driven outcomes, and global coverage for employers.
long_description: Spring Health is an enterprise mental health benefits platform that partners with employers to provide comprehensive mental health support to employees. The platform uses AI-powered precision matching to connect employees with the right level of care, whether that's self-guided digital content, coaching, therapy, or psychiatry. Spring Health is known for same-day appointment availability and measurable clinical outcomes, with peer-reviewed research demonstrating significant improvements in depression and anxiety symptoms. The company serves large enterprises globally and positions itself as a modern EAP replacement with higher utilization rates and better outcomes than traditional employee assistance programs.
one_liner: Enterprise mental health benefits platform with precision matching and data-driven outcomes.
best_for: Enterprise employers seeking data-driven mental health benefits with proven ROI
Organizations wanting to replace low-utilization traditional EAPs
Companies requiring fast access to care (same-day appointments)
Employers prioritizing measurable clinical outcomes and member satisfaction
Global organizations needing multi-country mental health support

compliance.notes: Enterprise mental health benefits platform - HIPAA compliant with healthcare security certifications.
